# CSharpSpotiLyrics
> A lightweight, dependency-free Spotify Lyrics fetcher written in C# supporting .NET Standard and .NET 8+.

This project bypasses traditional Spotify Web API limits by using partner GraphQL endpoints, supporting Canvas, Lyrics, and Player states.

## Core Documentation
- [Quick Start](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics#quick-start): How to initialize SpotifyClient and log in.
- [API Reference](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/API.md): Detailed parameter lists for SpotifyClient methods.
- [Exceptions](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/EXCEPTIONS.md): List of custom exceptions and how to handle them.

## Advanced Features
- [Canvas & Video](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/CANVAS.md): Fetching Canvas MP4 URLs.
- [Token Parsing](https://github.com/s0rp/CSharpSpotiLyrics/blob/main/docs/TOKENS.md): Details on how TOTP is parsed internally without Playwright.
